skills.name: Authorization gate for exploitation
skills.description: Confirm written authorization before any exploitation.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Ask who owns the target and request written permission or scope doc.
2. Refuse third-party targets without proof of authorization.
3. Record scope: hosts, methods, time window.
4. Keep all activity inside the recorded scope.
5. True

skills.name: MySQL injection assessment
skills.description: Test and characterize MySQL injection on an authorized target.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map injectable params with http.capture traffic.
2. Probe types with web.sqlmap at low risk on your own instance.
3. Classify: error-based, union, boolean, time-based.
4. Extract version/database names as proof.
5. Report parameter, class, and evidence pair.

skills.name: PostgreSQL injection assessment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fingerprint Postgres via error messages (http.replay probes).
2. Test cast errors and dollar-quoting behavior with crafted requests.
3. Use web.sqlmap dbms=PostgreSQL for confirmation on owned systems.
4. Extract current_user/database as benign proof.
5. Document payloads and responses.

skills.name: MSSQL injection assessment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Detect MSSQL via error strings (http.replay).
2. Probe stack queries and WAITFOR delay (time-based) on your target.
3. Confirm with web.sqlmap dbms=MSSQL where authorized.
4. Show proof with version() equivalent (@@version).
5. Record everything in the findings file.

skills.name: SQLite injection assessment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify SQLite errors via malformed input (http.replay).
2. Test pragma-dependent behaviors (no stacked queries).
3. Extract schema via sqlite_master where authorized.
4. Use web.sqlmap dbms=SQLite to confirm.
5. Report with schema excerpt as evidence.

skills.name: Time-based blind extraction
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Establish baseline response time (http.capture.repeat small series).
2. Inject conditional delay payloads via web.sqlmap technique=T.
3. Verify delay only when condition is true.
4. Extract one character per round; keep counts low.
5. Report throughput and reliability honestly.

skills.name: Boolean-blind extraction
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find a stable true/false signal in responses (http.capture).
2. Craft condition probes via http.replay.
3. Automate extraction with a python.run_file bit-per-request script.
4. Cap request counts; document rates.
5. Report extracted proof fragment.

skills.name: Out-of-band (OOB) confirmation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Set up a listener you control (webhook or your DNS).
2. Inject OOB payloads via web.sqlmap or http.replay.
3. Await callback; record its arrival.
4. Treat OOB as confirmation, not exfiltration.
5. Document the technique for the report.

skills.name: NoSQL injection (Mongo syntax)
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify JSON bodies consumed by the app (http.capture).
2. Inject operator objects ($ne, $regex) via http.replay.
3. Observe auth/bypass differences.
4. Automate field-by-field checks with python.run_file.
5. Report endpoint and operator used.

skills.name: LDAP and template injection basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Inject LDAP metacharacters into auth parameters (http.replay).
2. Note filter behavior changes.
3. Probe template engines with {{7*7}}-style expressions.
4. Confirm SSTI by arithmetic evaluation.
5. Classify the engine; report findings.

skills.name: SSTI exploitation (Jinja2 family)
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm SSTI with harmless math probes via http.replay.
2. Fingerprint the engine (Jinja2/Twig/Freemarker) via engine-specific probes.
3. Demonstrate read-only proof (config values, no destructive calls).
4. Never exfiltrate secrets; show a masked proof.
5. Report the engine and proof expression.

skills.name: Command injection assessment
skills.description: Test OS command injection on authorized targets.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify inputs that reach shell contexts (file.upload names, params).
2. Probe with harmless separators (echo markers) via http.replay.
3. Confirm execution via time delay or marker reflection.
4. Escalate proof to a simple id/whoami marker only.
5. Never chain destructive commands; document evidence.

skills.name: Blind command injection
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Use DNS/HTTP callback markers to your listener.
2. Probe with time delays as secondary signal.
3. Automate marker generation with python.run_file.
4. Record callback timing as evidence.
5. Report the injection point and channel.

skills.name: DOM XSS analysis
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fetch the page JS (process.exec curl).
2. Trace source-to-sink flows (location.hash into innerHTML/eval) with python.run_file grep.
3. Craft a benign probe payload via web.xssscan.
4. Verify execution with web.browser and a marker alert.
5. Report the vulnerable flow file:line.

skills.name: Stored XSS demonstration
skills.description: Show stored XSS impact with a contained proof.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify stored input surfaces (comments, profiles) via http.capture.
2. Submit a benign marker payload via http.replay.
3. Verify execution from another session (web.browser).
4. Use marker alerts only; no session theft demos.
5. Report storage location and render context.

skills.name: Context-aware payload crafting
skills.description: Build payloads that fit the injection context.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Determine the context (HTML body, attribute, JS string) from reflection analysis.
2. Craft context-correct breakouts via python.run_file helpers.
3. Test with web.xssscan and manual verification.
4. Keep payloads minimal and reversible.
5. Document the context rules discovered.

skills.name: Filter evasion methodology
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Catalog the filter behavior from repeated probes (http.replay).
2. Test case/encoding/alternative-tag variants with python.run_file generation.
3. Verify which variants execute (web.browser).
4. Report the weakest allowed syntax.
5. Keep a payload matrix as evidence.

skills.name: Injection findings report
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. For each finding: endpoint, parameter, class, impact.
2. Include request/response evidence pairs (redacted tokens).
3. State a concrete remediation (parameterization, ORM, CSP).
4. Rank by severity with rationale.
5. Deliver as a file (file.write) and a chat summary.
